title: The Cab Fare That Crashed the Lane

beats.theme: the cab surge on a rainy Monday: a girl with no car pays rising fares every wet Monday
beats.setting: a deadpan TV business-news bulletin, Monday Markets, charting her fare like a stock
beats.conflict: Priya's cab fare climbs to triple every rainy Monday and she blames the weather
beats.failedAttempt: wading to the main road in the rain to book from a cheaper pickup pin; umbrella flips, still triple
beats.twist: her cab driver reveals four people book from her gate at the same minute: her own neighbours are the demand
beats.lesson: when the whole lane rides alone, the whole lane pays triple
beats.appAngle: the live map shows how far the pool car is, so everyone stays dry indoors until it reaches the gate
beats.callback: closing bell: her fare flatlines and the bankrupt umbrella recovers

lines.text: Your cab costs triple when it rains. This girl lost a month of fares before she found out why.
No car. One umbrella. Same tech park as half her lane.
Rainy Monday one. One and a half times. Analysts blame drizzle.
Monday three. Triple. Her umbrella files for bankruptcy.
So Priya wades to the main road, to book from a cheaper pin.
The umbrella flips. Still triple. Now also soaked.
Then her driver, Raju, says the quiet part.
Madam, four people book from your gate. Same minute. Same tech park.
Rohan. Arjun. Sharma ji. And you.
The demand pumping her surge? Her own neighbours.
Lesson: when the whole lane rides alone, the whole lane pays triple.
So the four pooled up on an app. Arjun drives.
The live map shows exactly how far his car is.
Nobody waits in the rain. They step out when it's at the gate.
Closing bell. Priya's fare, flat. Her umbrella, out of bankruptcy.
Whole lane paying surge? Pool it on Sahyatri. Link in bio.

post.title: Why her cab cost 3x every rainy Monday 📈☔
post.caption: Priya blamed the rain for her surge fare three Mondays in a row. Then her cab driver Raju said the quiet part out loud. Tag the neighbour who books a cab from your gate every Monday.
